hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Numbers expressible as the sum of two positive cubes in multiple ways are Ramanujan numbers.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Precompute a^3 + b^3 for 1 <= a <= b such that the sum does not exceed n.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Collect sums that occur at least twice and return them in sorted ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Generates cube pairs for a, b <= n^(1/3) in O(n^(2/3)) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all integers up to n by factoring is significantly slower.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores sum counts in an associative table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generates cube pairs bounded by cube root of n and filters duplicates.
